title: Side Trails
message: Deck is direction-stage. Global Watch is an unlisted public field-test (standalone host).

projects.title: Waypoint Deck
projects.tagline: Offline-first Linux field computer · maps, weather, radio, local knowledge.
projects.description: A local-first field computer for when connectivity is poor or gone. Early-stage — do not assume these systems already ship.

projects.title: Global Watch
projects.description: Detect change. Identify unusual activity. Correlate independent evidence. Assess what the evidence supports. Public Field Test — not continuous monitoring, not an emergency warning system. Standalone application (not embedded in Studio).
